meta.title: GlotPress Stats - development site
meta.author: nilovelez
meta.description: Development site for GlotPress Stats. The plugin itself is mounted (Playground) or linked (Studio) from the repository, not installed by this blueprint.

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; $pages = array( 'glotstats-top' => array( 'GlotPress Stats: top', '[glotstats locale="es" directory="plugins" view="top"]' ), 'glotstats-tasks' => array( 'GlotPress Stats: tasks', '[glotstats locale="es" directory="plugins" view="tasks"]' ) ); foreach ( $pages as $slug => $page ) { $found = get_posts( array( 'name' => $slug, 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'any', 'numberposts' => 1 ) ); if ( empty( $found ) ) { wp_insert_post( array( 'post_name' => $slug, 'post_title' => $page[0], 'post_content' => $page[1], 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish' ) ); } }
